response.justification: Bogdan brings extensive Staff-level experience, a strong polyglot background, and highly relevant hands-on experience building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators. While he lacks explicit Python experience, his deep expertise in TypeScript, distributed high-throughput systems, and software craftsmanship make him an excellent fit for leading technical strategy in an AI-native environment.
strengths: Direct experience building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators.
Proven capability in high-throughput distributed systems, handling millions of requests per second.
Strong software craftsmanship mindset with extensive experience in TDD, CI/CD, and system architecture.
concerns: Lacks explicit professional experience with Python, which is listed as a must-have language.
His current Staff role involving AI is very recent, making the depth of his AI-native architectural experience unclear.
Extensive context switching across many languages (DLang, Node, C++) might require a ramp-up period to align with a specific tech stack.
